description: A tonneau-shaped case with an open-worked, tourbillon-inspired dial showing layered bridges and gears, on a black leather strap.

name: Blue Roman-Numeral Dress Watch
shortDescription: A rose-gold-tone dress watch with a blue Roman-numeral dial.
description: A royal-blue sunburst dial with applied Roman numerals in a polished rose-gold-tone case, on a blue leather strap.

name: Black Diver II
shortDescription: A steel diver with a black dial and black bezel.
description: A black dial with luminous-style dot markers and a matching black rotating-style bezel, a date window at three and a steel three-link bracelet.

name: Rose Gold Chronograph III
shortDescription: A rose-gold-tone chronograph with a salmon dial on brown leather.
description: A salmon dial with three matching sub-dials in a rose-gold-tone case with pump-style pushers, on a brown leather strap.

name: Green Textured Dial Sport Watch
shortDescription: A steel sport watch with a textured green dial.
description: A faceted steel case with an integrated bracelet and a textured green dial with applied baton markers.

name: Gold Pavé Bracelet Watch
shortDescription: A petite gold-tone watch with a pavé dial and bracelet.
description: A small round gold-tone watch with a pavé dial, stone-set bezel and a stone-set bracelet for evening.

name: Black Minimal Chronograph
shortDescription: A minimal steel watch with a black dial and small sub-dial.
description: A restrained black dial with slim markers and a single small sub-dial, in a polished steel case on a black leather strap.

name: Rotonde Dome Satchel
shortDescription: A rounded dome satchel in deep bordeaux grained leather.
description: A softly domed satchel in bordeaux grained leather, built on a flat structured base. A two-way gold zip runs over the top, and two rolled handles sit on stitched diamond tabs. A detachable, adjustable strap lets it go from hand to crossbody.

specifications.Interior: One zip pocket, two slip pockets

details: Rolled top handles on diamond tabs
care: Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth.
Store stuffed and in the dust bag provided.
Keep away from water, direct heat and prolonged sunlight.

name: Serif S-Lock Top-Handle
shortDescription: A blush top-handle bag closed with a sculpted gold S turn-lock.
description: A neat trapezoid top-handle in soft blush leather. The curved front flap closes with a sculpted gold S turn-lock, a nod to the Super Mimic mark. A padded top handle and a detachable shoulder strap make it a day-to-evening piece.
care: Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth.
Store stuffed and in the dust bag provided.
Light colours can take on dye from denim; avoid prolonged contact.

name: Atelier Tab Tote
shortDescription: A structured taupe tote with a gold-bar tab closure.
description: A roomy, structured tote in taupe pebbled leather with clean side gussets. A leather tab with a slim gold bar closes the centre, two rolled handles sit on teardrop tabs, and a detachable strap is included for crossbody wear.
details: Leather tab closure with gold bar
care: Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth.
Store stuffed and in the dust bag provided.
Keep away from water, direct heat and prolonged sunlight.

name: Orbe Turn-Lock Shoulder Bag

images.alt: Orbe Turn-Lock Shoulder Bag in Noir

shortDescription: A black flap shoulder bag with a round gold turn-lock and chain strap.
description: A compact flap bag in black grained leather that sits close under the arm. A round gold turn-lock closes the flap. Wear it on the leather shoulder strap, or switch to the detachable gold chain for a longer crossbody drop.
care: Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth.
Store flat in the dust bag provided.
Wipe the chain with a dry cloth to keep its shine.

name: Plissé Top-Handle
shortDescription: A soft ivory top-handle with pleated sides and a square gold clasp.
description: A rounded top-handle bag in ivory smooth leather. Softly pleated side panels let it open wide while the shape stays neat. The curved flap closes with a small square gold clasp, and a padded rolled handle sits on gold links.
details: Curved flap with square gold clasp
care: Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth.
Store stuffed and in the dust bag provided.
Light colours can take on dye from denim; avoid prolonged contact.
